applications.title: GrowthTrack workspace
applications.purpose: A desktop workspace for personal growth, work, family, equity and Forex research, with a dedicated customer-admin area for the separate FinSync and OxFin products.
applications.runtime: Node.js/npm workspace; Ultimate uses React, Vite and Express. Companion services retain their current frameworks.
applications.recordedStatus: The existing application runs through a shared local launcher. A new isolated UI demo is ready for review; native module consolidation and real customer-admin adapters are planned.

applications.title: GrowthTrack Ultimate
applications.purpose: The desktop portal for personal growth, work, insights and family/market modules, and the future customer-admin home for FinSync and OxFin.
applications.runtime: React, Vite, Express, Prisma/SQLite; optional Electron desktop packaging and Three.js physique tools.
applications.recordedStatus: Existing authenticated application plus a separate interactive redesign demo. Live customer management and native companion migrations remain planned.

applications.title: FinSync
applications.purpose: A separate customer finance application for budgets, spending, account connections and financial planning, with web and mobile source packages.
applications.runtime: npm workspaces, Next.js web frontend, Firebase integration and Expo mobile source.
applications.recordedStatus: Customer application under development. Its customer administration belongs in GrowthTrack Ultimate; the customer app is not merged into Ultimate.

applications.title: FinSync Web
applications.purpose: The customer-facing FinSync web interface for sign-in, onboarding, spending, budgets and account settings.
applications.runtime: Next.js App Router, React and Firebase.
applications.recordedStatus: Independent customer app. Future administrator pages are owned by Ultimate.

applications.title: FinSync Mobile
applications.purpose: The Expo mobile application source for the FinSync customer product.
applications.recordedStatus: Mobile source retained. Desktop portal redesign is the current priority; this is not a completed mobile feature audit.

applications.title: OxFin

applications.runtime: Next.js web application, PostgreSQL/Redis infrastructure and reference service prototypes.
applications.recordedStatus: Under development. Ultimate is the target for OxFin customer administration; existing service prototypes are not a production admin backend.

applications.title: OxFin Web
applications.purpose: The independent OxFin customer interface for wallets, cards, bills and investment workflows.
applications.recordedStatus: Customer application under development. Shared customer-admin adapters are planned in Ultimate.
